Defiled sandstone is the solid natural rock under the Defiled Lands' sand, stone as vanilla sandstone is, though the rules read sandstone as decorative. Named at the value the census judged, so its stairs and the rest of the mod's made blocks stay as the rules leave them.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.12.2 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does, at the values that hold its full block's own material. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
